card.name: Final digits of dose step sizes
card.fires_on: The last digit of a number (usually the 0 in 500, 250 or 100) that gives the size of a dose increase, just before mg and the word increments. It appears in titration instructions such as 'increased by 500 mg' or 'in increments of 50<<0>> mg'.

modes.label: Step size before mg increments
modes.description: A trailing digit in the amount by which a dose is raised, followed by mg and increments.

modes.label: Step size after 'increased by'
modes.description: A trailing digit of the amount added when the dose is raised, with no word increments yet.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word increments (and similar words such as increment and incremental) coming next.
card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a number that says how much to raise a dose each step, where the word increments is about to follow.
